crossRefs.note: The king went to Gibeon to sacrifice there; for that was the great high place. Solomon offered a thousand burnt…
Solomon offered for the sacrifice of peace offerings, which he offered to Yahweh, twenty two thousand head of cattle…
They sacrificed sacrifices to Yahweh, and offered burnt offerings to Yahweh, on the next day after that day, even one…
Lebanon is not sufficient to burn, nor its animals sufficient for a burnt offering.

people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

translations.web: Solomon went up there to the bronze altar before Yahweh, which was at the Tent of Meeting, and offered one thousand burnt offerings on it.
translations.bsb: Solomon offered sacrifices there before the LORD on the bronze altar at the Tent of Meeting, where he offered a thousand burnt offerings.
translations.kjv: And Solomon went up thither to the brasen altar before the LORD, which was at the tabernacle of the congregation, and offered a thousand burnt offerings upon it.
translations.asv: And Solomon went up thither to the brazen altar before Jehovah, which was at the tent of meeting, and offered a thousand burnt-offerings upon it.
